items.claim: Michael Oliveira has pretty good overall durability despite being rocked and hurt at times.
items.quote: I looked at Michael Oliveira's tape. He's pretty durable. You know, there are times where he's been rocked, where he's been hurt and dazed a little bit. However, I feel like his durability's pretty good overall.

items.claim: Oban Elliot does not have that much knockout power.
items.quote: Oban Elliot does not have that much knockout power.

items.claim: Michael Oliveira did not seem to have the best weight cut.
items.quote: didn't seem to have the best weight cut that we saw.

items.claim: Oban Elliot has only lost one decision in his entire life.
items.quote: the man has only lost one decision in his entire life.

items.claim: Gilbert Urbina is damn sure landing a takedown if the fight extends.
items.quote: I think if this fight extends, I think Gilbert Urbina's damn sure landing a takedown.

items.claim: Vlasto Cepo has been taken down by a not great level of competition.
items.quote: We have seen him taken down by a not great level of competition.

items.claim: Dusko Todorovic is a BJJ black belt who has never been submitted before.
items.quote: Dusko Todorovic is a BJJ black belt who's never been submitted before.

items.claim: Dusko Todorovic has the worst durability in terms of his chin between him and Robert Valentin.
items.quote: I think whichever one of these guys has the worst durability in terms of their chin, it's definitely Dusko.

items.claim: Robert Valentin probably has better cardio overall than Dusko Todorovic.
items.quote: I think Valentin probably does have the better cardio overall as well, too.
